parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_received FROM email_triage_logs WHERE ((created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;

SELECT id,ticket_code,sender_email,title,category,priority,status,created_at FROM tickets WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY CASE WHEN priority ILIKE '%P1%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,created_at ASC LIMIT 500;

WITH events AS (SELECT id,sender_email,subject,body_snippet,category,priority,sentiment,urgency_reason,status,created_at,((created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date AS event_date FROM email_triage_logs WHERE ((created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - 7 AND ((created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date <= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date), daily AS (SELECT event_date,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment ILIKE '%tieu cuc%' OR sentiment ILIKE '%negative%' OR priority ILIKE '%P1%' OR urgency_reason ILIKE '%complaint%' OR urgency_reason ILIKE '%khieu nai%' OR urgency_reason ILIKE '%urgent%')::int AS incident_count FROM events GROUP BY event_date), issues AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE sentiment ILIKE '%tieu cuc%' OR sentiment ILIKE '%negative%' OR priority ILIKE '%P1%' OR urgency_reason ILIKE '%complaint%' OR urgency_reason ILIKE '%khieu nai%' OR urgency_reason ILIKE '%urgent%') SELECT i.id,i.sender_email,i.subject,i.body_snippet,i.category,i.priority,i.sentiment,i.urgency_reason,i.status,d.event_date,d.incident_count FROM daily d LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.event_date=d.event_date ORDER BY d.event_date DESC,i.created_at DESC LIMIT 1000;

parameters.jsCode: const date=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'}).format(new Date()),count=Number($('L4-02 Count Total Inbound').first().json.total_received||0),tickets=$('L4-03 Query Pending Tickets').all().map(x=>x.json).filter(x=>x.id!==undefined),rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json).filter(x=>x.event_date!==undefined),signals=rows.filter(x=>x.id!==undefined),dailyCounts={};for(const row of rows){const day=String(row.event_date).slice(0,10);dailyCounts[day]=Number(row.incident_count||0);}const current=signals.filter(x=>String(x.event_date).slice(0,10)===date),historicalDays=Object.keys(dailyCounts).filter(day=>day<date),categories={},priorities={};for(const row of current){const cat=row.category||'Uncategorized',pri=row.priority||'Unspecified';categories[cat]=(categories[cat]||0)+1;priorities[pri]=(priorities[pri]||0)+1;}const p1=current.filter(x=>String(x.priority||'').toUpperCase().includes('P1')).length;const reportFacts={date,total_received:count,total_pending_tickets:tickets.length,total_p1:p1,negative_issues:current,categories,priorities};const ai_prompt='Analyze only these operational inbox facts; do not invent trends. If evidence is insufficient, say exactly: Không đủ dữ liệu để kết luận. Return JSON {key_insights:[],risk_summary:string,recommendations:[]} with short operational recommendations only.\\nDATA: '+JSON.stringify(reportFacts);const gemini_request_body={contents:[{parts:[{text:ai_prompt}]}],generationConfig:{responseMimeType:'application/json',temperature:0.1}};return[{json:{date,total_received:count,total_pending_tickets:tickets.length,pending_tickets:tickets,total_p1:p1,negative_issues:current,categories,priorities,incident_current:Number(dailyCounts[date]||0),incident_baseline_sum:historicalDays.reduce((sum,day)=>sum+dailyCounts[day],0),baseline_days:historicalDays.length,baseline_daily_counts:dailyCounts,gemini_request_body}}];

const stats=$('L4-05 Aggregate Stats').first().json,raw=$input.first().json;let ai={key_insights:[],risk_summary:'Không đủ dữ liệu để kết luận.',recommendations:[]};try{const text=raw.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.map(p=>p.text||'').join('').trim()||raw.text||'',fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3),clean=text.startsWith(fence)?text.slice(text.indexOf(String.fromCharCode(10))+1).split(fence)[0].trim():text,a=clean.indexOf('{'),b=clean.lastIndexOf('}'),parsed=JSON.parse(clean.slice(a,b+1));ai={key_insights:Array.isArray(parsed.key_insights)?parsed.key_insights:[],risk_summary:String(parsed.risk_summary||ai.risk_summary),recommendations:Array.isArray(parsed.recommendations)?parsed.recommendations:[]};}catch(e){}const p1Issues=stats.negative_issues.filter(x=>String(x.priority||'').toUpperCase().includes('P1')).map(x=>'- '+x.subject+' ('+x.sender_email+')');const lines=['# Daily Inbox Intelligence','','Report date: '+stats.date,'','## Tổng quan','- Email tiếp nhận: '+stats.total_received,'- Ticket đang chờ: '+stats.total_pending_tickets,'- P1/Critical: '+stats.total_p1,'','## Ticket tồn đọng',...(stats.pending_tickets.length?stats.pending_tickets.slice(0,20).map(t=>'- '+t.ticket_code+': '+t.title+' ('+t.priority+', '+t.status+')'):['- Không có ticket tồn đọng.']),'','## Vấn đề tiêu cực',...(stats.negative_issues.length?stats.negative_issues.slice(0,20).map(x=>'- '+x.subject+' | '+x.category+' | '+x.priority+' | '+x.sentiment):['- Không có vấn đề tiêu cực/khẩn cấp được ghi nhận.']),'','## P1/Critical',...(p1Issues.length?p1Issues:['- Không có P1/Critical.']).slice(0,20),'','## AI Insights',...(ai.key_insights.length?ai.key_insights.map(x=>'- '+(typeof x==='string'?x:JSON.stringify(x))):['- Không đủ dữ liệu để kết luận.']),'','## Risk',ai.risk_summary,'','## Recommendations',...(ai.recommendations.length?ai.recommendations.map(x=>'- '+x):['- Không đủ dữ liệu để kết luận.'])];return[{json:{...stats,...ai,markdown_digest:lines.join('\n')}}];

parameters.query: SELECT r.recipient_email,(SELECT recipient_email FROM daily_digest_recipients WHERE is_active=TRUE AND recipient_type='OPERATIONS' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AS operations_email FROM daily_digest_recipients r WHERE r.is_active=TRUE AND r.recipient_type='EXECUTIVE' ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 100;

INSERT INTO daily_summaries (summary_date,total_received,total_pending_tickets,total_p1,negative_issues,categories,priorities,key_insights,risk_summary,recommendations,markdown_digest,html_digest,incident_count,baseline_count,incident_spike) VALUES ($1::date,$2,$3,$4,$5::jsonb,$6::jsonb,$7::jsonb,$8,$9,$10::jsonb,$11,$12,$13,$14,$15) ON CONFLICT(summary_date) DO UPDATE SET total_received=EXCLUDED.total_received,total_pending_tickets=EXCLUDED.total_pending_tickets,total_p1=EXCLUDED.total_p1,negative_issues=EXCLUDED.negative_issues,categories=EXCLUDED.categories,priorities=EXCLUDED.priorities,key_insights=EXCLUDED.key_insights,risk_summary=EXCLUDED.risk_summary,recommendations=EXCLUDED.recommendations,markdown_digest=EXCLUDED.markdown_digest,html_digest=EXCLUDED.html_digest,incident_count=EXCLUDED.incident_count,baseline_count=EXCLUDED.baseline_count,incident_spike=EXCLUDED.incident_spike RETURNING id;
